hook: Allyn Shaw is listed by Reuters Events as Chief Business Execution and Risk Officer, Truist, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York. According to Allyn Shaw's LinkedIn profile, the post, executive vice president and chief business execution and risk officer, began in March 2025, after Wells Fargo, where the profile lists the role of COO for enterprise generative AI and consumer technology.

editor_points.desc: According to Allyn Shaw's LinkedIn profile: EVP, chief business execution and risk officer at Truist since March 2025; EVP, COO of enterprise GenAI and consumer technology at Wells Fargo from 2023 to 2025; president and CIO/CTO of Recycle Track Systems from 2019 to 2021; at Bank of America and Countrywide from 2004 to 2019, including managing director and COO of cyber security and global head of product management, technology. The profile names the person Allyn L. Shaw. The profile is Allyn Shaw's own account and has not been checked against other records.
